correctness.rationale: A*B is an exact S6-equivariant simplicial join: all duad–syntheme distances are at most three; within each class edges are exactly its incidence-concurrency or disjointness relations. The two factors are each a 15-triangle complex equivariantly homotopy equivalent to the 45-edge connected incidence graph. From exact augmented chains, chi_H1(g)=number of g-fixed flags minus fixed duads minus fixed synthemes plus one. Independent signed-chain traces match all 720 elements. This trace character has dimension16, norm one, and matches the Frobenius-alternant Specht character (3,2,1) on 11 cycle types. Natural join Künneth yields H3=S321 tensor S321; explicit rational character inner products give the 11 exact multiplicities totalling256. Supplied verify.py and verify_rips.py were executed from actual package source paths. The proof is finite and complete for this graph, not an induction on graph order.
